description: This source file defines the OpenTypeFontWriter class responsible for writing TrueType font files within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for writing font table tags and manages font data streams.

classes.name: OpenTypeFontWriter
classes.description: A class for writing OpenType font files, specifically TrueType fonts, to a stream.
